name: Toyama

queries.query: Toyama City official cadastral map parcel public GIS Japan
queries.result: Found Toyama City official open-data parcel-number reference-map dataset and the official Infomap viewer; the open-data page publishes a 2026 ZIP resource.

queries.query: 富山市 地籍図 公開 GIS 筆界 地番
queries.result: Found Toyama City’s official 地番参考図 notice, open-data ZIP, and official Infomap map 33. The notice says the map is a reference drawing, not a certified survey or rights document, and some areas are not drawn.

officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official notice says the city publishes a 地番参考図, searchable in Infomap and downloadable as SHAPE; it is a reference drawing and not usable as a survey, rights, or legal-boundary document; some areas are not provided.
Official catalog lists 2026-01-01 and 2025-01-01 parcel-reference ZIP resources. The resource page identifies the current 2026 ZIP download.

Official viewer advertises 地番参考図 map 33. Current configuration exposes layer tree 154 with 大字, 小字, 地番 and 筆界 layers; public map projection configuration includes EPSG:2449 / JGD2000 plane rectangular zone 7 and WGS84 conversion parameters.
